name: Sakai Takayuki
description: Sakai Takayuki is one of the most respected knife brands from Sakai, the historic center of Japanese knife-making. With roots dating back to 1946, they produce an extensive range from traditional single-bevel knives to modern Western-style blades using premium steels like Aogami Super and VG-10.
descriptionJa: 堺孝行は、日本の刃物の聖地・堺を代表するブランド。1946年の創業以来、伝統的な片刃包丁からモダンな洋包丁まで幅広いラインナップを展開。青紙スーパーやVG-10など最高級鋼材を使用。
specialty: Traditional single-bevel knives, wide range of steels

name: Masahiro
description: Masahiro has been crafting knives in Seki City since 1932. Known for their excellent value proposition, they produce professional-grade knives that are widely used in Japanese culinary schools. Their MV series with molybdenum-vanadium stainless steel is particularly popular.
descriptionJa: 正広は1932年創業の関市を代表するメーカー。日本の調理師学校で広く採用される高品質な業務用包丁を製造。モリブデンバナジウム鋼のMVシリーズが特に人気。
specialty: Professional kitchen knives, culinary school standard

name: Tojiro
description: Tojiro, based in the metalworking capital of Tsubame-Sanjo, is renowned for offering exceptional quality at accessible prices. Their DP series with VG-10 cobalt alloy steel is considered the best entry point into Japanese knives. Professional chefs worldwide trust Tojiro for daily use.
descriptionJa: 藤次郎は金属加工の街・燕三条に拠点を置くメーカー。VG-10コバルト合金鋼を使用したDPシリーズは、日本包丁への入門に最適な名品。世界中のプロ料理人に愛用されている。
specialty: High-value VG-10 knives, excellent entry-level options

name: Misono
description: Misono is a premium knife manufacturer from Seki City, beloved by professional chefs in Japan. Their UX10 series is considered one of the finest stainless steel knife lines available. Known for exceptional fit and finish, Misono knives are a status symbol in Japanese professional kitchens.
descriptionJa: ミソノは関市の高級包丁メーカー。UX10シリーズは最高峰のステンレス包丁として知られる。優れた仕上がりと切れ味で、日本のプロ料理人の間でステータスシンボル的存在。
specialty: Premium stainless steel knives, professional chef favorite

name: Global
description: Global revolutionized the knife industry in 1985 with their iconic one-piece stainless steel design. Made by Yoshikin in Tsubame-Sanjo, these knives feature a distinctive dimpled handle and CROMOVA 18 stainless steel. Their modern aesthetic and lightweight design have won international acclaim.
descriptionJa: グローバルは1985年、吉田金属工業がオールステンレス一体構造で包丁業界に革新をもたらした。特徴的なディンプルハンドルとCROMOVA18ステンレス鋼を採用。モダンなデザインで世界的に高い評価。

name: Shun
description: Shun, a brand by Kai Corporation (founded 1908), is one of the most recognized Japanese knife brands globally. Famous for their Damascus-clad VG-MAX steel blades and elegant D-shaped handles. The Classic series is the gateway for many Western cooks into Japanese cutlery.
descriptionJa: 旬は貝印（1908年創業）のプレミアムブランド。ダマスカス模様のVG-MAX鋼とエレガントなD型ハンドルで世界的に知名度が高い。クラシックシリーズは多くの西洋料理人の日本包丁入門となっている。

name: Aritsugu
description: Aritsugu is Japan's oldest cutlery maker, established in 1560 in Kyoto. Originally sword smiths, they transitioned to kitchen knives and have served the Imperial Court. Their shop in Nishiki Market is a Kyoto landmark. Each knife is hand-forged by master craftsmen using traditional techniques.
descriptionJa: 有次は1560年創業の日本最古の刃物メーカー。元は刀鍛冶で、御所御用達の歴史を持つ。京都・錦市場の本店は観光名所。熟練の職人が伝統技法で一本一本手打ちで鍛造。

name: Masamoto Sohonten
description: Masamoto Sohonten, founded in 1834, is the most prestigious knife brand among Tokyo's sushi chefs. Located in Tsukiji, they are legendary for their single-bevel knives, especially yanagiba. The KS series with Swedish carbon steel is their flagship professional line.
descriptionJa: 正本総本店は1834年創業、東京の鮨職人に最も愛される包丁ブランド。築地に本店を構え、特に柳刃包丁は伝説的。スウェーデン鋼のKSシリーズがプロ向けフラッグシップ。

name: Sugimoto
description: Sugimoto, established in 1930 in Tokyo, is revered among Chinese cuisine chefs in Japan. Their carbon steel Chinese cleavers and gyutos are workhorses in professional kitchens. Known for excellent heat treatment and robust construction that stands up to heavy daily use.
descriptionJa: 杉本は1930年東京で創業。日本の中華料理人に絶大な信頼を得るメーカー。カーボンスチールの中華包丁や牛刀は、プロの厨房で酷使に耐える堅牢さが特徴。熱処理の技術に定評。
specialty: Carbon steel professional knives, Chinese cleavers

name: Konosuke
description: Konosuke is a relatively new but highly respected brand from Sakai, known for their thin, laser-like grinds and exceptional fit and finish. Their knives are made by top Sakai craftsmen and represent the cutting edge of modern Japanese knife-making. Popular among knife enthusiasts worldwide.
descriptionJa: 子の日は堺の比較的新しいブランドながら、薄くレーザーのような刃付けと卓越した仕上がりで高い評価。堺の一流職人が製造し、現代日本包丁の最先端を体現。世界中の包丁愛好家に人気。

name: Takamura
description: Takamura, based in Echizen (Fukui Prefecture), is celebrated for their ultra-thin, razor-sharp knives using SG2/R2 powdered steel. Their Chromax and R2 series are cult favorites among knife enthusiasts. Known for incredibly light weight and laser-like cutting performance.
descriptionJa: 高村は越前（福井県）を拠点とし、SG2/R2粉末鋼を使用した超薄刃・超鋭利な包丁で高い評価。ChromaxとR2シリーズは包丁マニアの間でカルト的人気。驚異的な軽さとレーザーのような切れ味が特徴。
